The interaction between these two specific remedies under the general §280 umbrella is tense.

Integration conflict. §281(5) triggers the debtor's right to reclaim under §§346-348 when the creditor claims damages for the whole performance. This forces an interaction between the remedy for non-performance (damages) and the legal consequences of rescission (return of benefits). While specified, it merges two different legal constructs (enforcement of a secondary claim vs. unwinding a contract), which could lead to underspecified priority or calculation conflicts (e.g., valuing benefits under §346 vs. calculating damages under §281).
